the legal screen fading in from black at different phases (port 79 vs oracle 100: same dHash family 0f0f.., mean blue 39.7 vs 23.7); both legs' first image event is within 4 frames (timeline WaitingForLoader/Starting)

disc assets: the PAL loading card is a full-width artwork with CARREGANDO, the NTSC one a boxed artwork over a blue disc with LOADING (pairs/LoadingTitle_460_1100.png); same scene, different artwork + language + aspect fit

the oracle's title WORLD renders as a translucent slab over a white/blue sea (consistent with PCSX2 showing the island); the sample also sits on the loading-card -> title cross-fade (the port's 560 is the last CARREGANDO frame, the oracle's 1200 the fade over its world + "THREE YEARS AGO..."): acceptable fade timing on top of the oracle's world bug
